row.evidence: Playvox is now sold as "Playvox by NiCE" through a "Get a quote" page with no tier table; Okta's catalogue lists a PlayVox app with SCIM provisioning (Create, Update, Deactivate), but Playvox's own provisioning docs sit behind the customer login, so the plan gate is not public.
row.notes: Status unchanged (unknown). playvox.com now redirects to the my.playvox.com login (playvox.com/pricing 404s), and the product is sold as Playvox by NiCE on a quote-request page, so June's Starter ~$15 / Professional ~$30 / Enterprise ~$40 per agent tier prices have no first-party source and are dropped. New finding: Okta's OIN PlayVox app (last updated May 2020) has SAML, SWA and SCIM checked with Create, Update and Deactivate provisioning (read from the page markup), so SCIM exists, but which plan includes it is not published. The public help centre exposes 9 articles; the rest needs a Playvox login. A public REST API (HTTP Basic with API keys, 100 requests/min) can create, list and update/deactivate users and manage teams; its plan gate is not documented.

plans.name: Playvox by NiCE (quote)
plans.notes: No public tier table; NiCE's main /pricing page lists CXone suites only.

scim.notes: Evidence of SCIM comes only from Okta's catalogue (SCIM box checked in page markup); Playvox's own SCIM docs, if any, are behind the help-centre login. Okta also shows Create, Update and Deactivate checked; kept out of scim.operations and row.scim_ops because methodology takes those from vendor docs only.

endpoints.purpose: List users (page, per_page, query, fields, sort)
Create a user (name, last_name, username, email, password, roles, integration IDs)
Update a user; status inactive/active deactivates or reactivates
Bulk update user custom fields (queued job)
Add a user to a team
Remove a user from a team

rate_limits.text: 100 requests per minute per API key by default; higher limits via Customer Success or Sales.

limitations.text: No delete-user endpoint is documented; users are deactivated by setting status to inactive.

okta.notes: OIN page markup marks SAML, SWA and SCIM, plus provisioning Create, Update, Deactivate (no Group Push). Last updated May 27, 2020. Builder not stated.

entra.notes: Help centre mentions Azure SSO; learn.microsoft.com playvox-tutorial returns 404.

onelogin.notes: Help centre mentions OneLogin SSO; connector page not checked (blocks bots).
